err.peer_outdated: The other device runs an older Pulsar. Update it to connect with a password.
err.hostCaps: The host did not report its stream capabilities, so the connection could not be secured. Try again.
err.hostNoEncryptedMedia: The host does not support encrypted video (old version). Pulsar never starts an unencrypted stream; update the host.
err.portInUse: Port is in use — pick a different one in Settings → Network, or leave it empty
err.relayResolve: Could not resolve the relay server
host.encodeFailed: Video encoder failed to start — no encoder worked; tried
host.windowPortalPick: Pick the window on this computer (Wayland)
host.captureNoFrames: Can't capture the screen: the host gets no picture from its graphics card. Try restarting Pulsar on the host.
host.captureNoFramesMac: Can't capture the screen: the host Mac delivers no picture to Pulsar (ScreenCaptureKit). Check the Screen Recording permission on the host, then restart Pulsar there.
host.screenPermission: Can't capture the screen: the host Mac hasn't given Pulsar the Screen Recording permission (System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording). Grant it and restart Pulsar.
host.plaintextRefused: This client did not ask for encrypted video (old version). No unencrypted stream was started; update the client.
host.mediaForwarderFailed: The host could not open the encrypted video channel; no stream was started. Try connecting again.
err.identityChanged: The identity behind this device has changed. Accept the new identity and reconnect?
err.localRelayBind: Could not start the in-app relay (the port may be in use)
update.inProgress: Pulsar is being updated. It will open by itself once the install finishes — give it a few seconds.
ds5.shed.speaker: Weak Bluetooth: controller speaker turned off
ds5.shed.mic: Weak Bluetooth: controller mic turned off
ds5.shed.haptics: Weak Bluetooth: HD haptics turned off, using classic rumble
ds5.restore.speaker: Bluetooth recovered: controller speaker back on
ds5.restore.mic: Bluetooth recovered: controller mic back on
ds5.restore.haptics: Bluetooth recovered: HD haptics back on
ds5.shed.headset: Weak Bluetooth: audio to the controller headset jack stopped
ds5.restore.headset: Bluetooth recovered: audio back on the controller headset jack
ds5.headset.off: Headphones unplugged: audio plays on this device again
hint.wifi24: Wi-Fi is on 2.4 GHz: latency may rise and a Bluetooth controller suffers. Use a 5/6 GHz network if you can
hint.wlanPowerSave: Wi-Fi power saving is on while on battery: the stream may stall. Plug in, or set the wireless adapter to "Maximum Performance" in the power plan
pad.client.title: Player {n}'s controller does nothing on the other side
pad.client.mac_entitlement: the Mac's Pulsar build lacks the virtual controller permission (signing)
pad.client.mac_unsupported: the Mac's macOS is too old for a virtual controller (10.15 or newer needed)
pad.client.vigem_missing: the ViGEmBus driver is not installed on Windows
pad.client.unavailable: the virtual controller could not be created
pad.host.mac_entitlement: This Pulsar build lacks the virtual controller permission (signing); controller input does not reach games
pad.host.mac_unsupported: This macOS is too old for a virtual controller (10.15 or newer needed)
pad.host.vigem_missing: The ViGEmBus driver is not installed; controller input does not reach games
pad.host.uinput_denied: /dev/uinput is not writable; controller input does not reach games
pad.host.unavailable: The virtual controller could not be created; controller input does not reach games
input.client.title: Your mouse and keyboard do not reach the other side
input.client.uinput_denied: no access to /dev/uinput on Linux (udev rule missing)
input.client.mac_accessibility: Pulsar has no Accessibility permission on the Mac
input.client.win_elevated: the window you click or type into runs as administrator and Pulsar there does not
input.client.win_secure_desktop: a UAC prompt or the lock screen is open there; input does not reach it without the Pulsar helper service
input.client.android_control_off: the Pulsar control service (Accessibility) is off on the phone
input.client.android_control_missing: this Pulsar build on the phone cannot be controlled (no control service); install the host-control version
input.client.unavailable: the other side cannot pass input to its desktop
input.host.uinput_denied: /dev/uinput is not writable; remote mouse and keyboard do not work. Click to set it up
input.host.mac_accessibility: No Accessibility permission; remote mouse and keyboard do not work. Click to open it
input.host.win_elevated: Remote input goes to an administrator window; Pulsar is not elevated, so it does not reach it
input.host.win_secure_desktop: A UAC prompt or the lock screen is open; remote input does not reach it
input.host.android_control_off: The control service is off; remote touch does not work
input.host.android_control_missing: This build has no control service; remote touch does not work
input.host.unavailable: Remote mouse and keyboard cannot reach this computer
input.host.uinput_no_seat: The uinput rule is installed but /dev/uinput is not writable: this session is not local (SSH / headless). Add the user to the input group
input.host.uinput_fixed: uinput rule installed; remote mouse and keyboard work now
fw.macPrompt: Pulsar wants to allow itself and its streaming programs through the firewall so remote connections can reach it.
